gallery: Black It's Better To Be Lucky patch hat, front
buyBody: The same woven patch, on black. Quieter than the white one and it hides a season of wear better, which is the argument for every black hat ever made.
pieceHeadline: The same line, said more quietly
pieceParas: Black does two useful things. It makes the patch the only thing on the hat you look at, and it survives being sat on, rained on and left in a car boot without showing you every minute of it.
If you own one Lucky hat and you want it to go with the rest of your golf wardrobe without thinking about it, this is the one.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Late light, golfer at address or leaning on a bag. Black hat needs a bright background to separate — sky or fairway, not trees. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
